notes.title: BGs updated, sneak peak inside!
notes.notes:
[h2]Howdy![/h2]

As part of my ongoing efforts to shape-up the game from its Early Version into its Steam Launch version, I've been working on switching the backgrounds over from a 3D-render style to a more cohesive, 2D, comic-book look.

Three major backgrounds have already been updated with two more presently in production. I'm expecting background production to replace existing backgrounds will continue another 2 weeks, at which time I expect all or nearly-all backgrounds will have been recreated and replaced.

Be sure to join the Discord if want to get even [i]closer[/i] looks at all the upcoming changes as we run up to the game's release on Steam. The Discord is also where you can find links to funding the game with donations and it's where I'll be pulling beta testers from when the Steam Build gets closer to launch.

Anyway, it's nice to meet all y'all on Steam and I look forward to continuing to share my updates and progress on this title as the work continues.

[i]Enjoy![/i]
